title: Pupuk Mahal Jangan Sampai Terbuang
hook: Pupuk sekarang makin mahal jadi sayang kalau ditabur nempel pangkal batang karena yang ngambil bukan akar yang kerja.
story: Pak Vincent berdiri di tepi piringan sebuah pokok sawit yang sudah menghasilkan di kebun Riau. Sejak detik 0.0s ember plastik berisi butiran pupuk sudah di tangan kirinya dan tangan kanannya menebar satu genggam pupuk ke tanah piringan. Ia bicara singkat bahwa pupuk sekarang mahal sehingga cara taburnya harus benar, lalu ia menunjuk ke arah pangkal batang dan bilang jangan ditabur nempel pokok, tabur di piringan sekitar satu setengah meter dari pangkal supaya akar serabut yang menyerap. Ia kembali menatap lensa, senyum bersahaja, angguk kecil. Situasi harian di kebun, bukan kejadian baru dalam canon.
caption:
Pupuk makin mahal jadi sayang kalau ditabur nempel pangkal batang. Di pokok yang sudah menghasilkan lebih baik ditabur di piringan sekitar satu setengah meter dari pangkal. Di kebun kawan-kawan jarak taburnya berapa meter?

shots.prompt: Authentic handheld smartphone vlog video of Pak Vincent the exact same Indonesian man shown in the two attached reference photos (three-expression sheet and full-body turnaround). Output exactly ONE man in ONE continuous shot never a collage split screen or reference-sheet layout. Vertical 9:16 10 seconds medium shot waist-up framing at eye level with slight natural handheld sway. Location: the weeded circular ground ring around the base of one mature oil palm tree that is already producing fruit, inside a smallholding in Riau, with reddish-brown soil, a few dry frond pieces at the outer edge and other palm trunks softly out of focus behind him under soft overcast late-afternoon daylight. He wears the vintage royal blue Samsung football jersey dark shorts dark baseball cap and rubber work sandals with lean wiry build sun-tanned weathered skin fine pores smile lines and a thin mustache. PROP CONTINUITY: from 0.0s until the last frame his left hand already holds one small yellow plastic pail filled with pale grey granular fertilizer at hip height and that pail stays clearly visible in frame the entire time with nothing appearing or disappearing mid-take, no sack, no scoop, no other tools entering the shot. At 0.0s his right hand is already tossing one small handful of the pale grey granules down onto the weeded ground ring and the granules land and stay on the soil. He speaks in natural friendly Indonesian with a warm Riau tone one short sentence saying fertilizer is expensive now and warning not to spread it against the base of the trunk. Around the fifth second he stops scattering lifts his right hand and points toward the lower trunk of the palm in front of him while finishing the sentence that it should be spread on the ground ring about one and a half meters from the trunk because the feeding roots are out there. At the eighth second his right hand returns beside the pail he looks straight into the lens with a modest calm smile and a small nod. Shot on a smartphone vlog camera natural clean daylight neutral white balance 5500K true-to-life colors realistic matte human skin with visible fine pores no plastic shine no waxy skin no glass skin no yellow or orange tint no artificial golden glow zero CGI authentic non-AI documentary look. Clean frame with no baked-in text no subtitles no camera information bar no fps or color-temperature readout no location label no timestamps no watermark no logo and no other people in focus.
